描述_EN: Although poorly preserved, it is known to have been excavated in 1904 (1991) from a small hillside south of Yaqiao and has high material value. Its features are similar to those of the Shigu type of the first half of the Middle Period, but it is possible that this small four-section bronze bell with a pair of decorative ears on the upper edge of the fins was made in this area, since it was excavated in the China region.
描述_ZN: 虽然保存得不好，但已知它是1904年（1991年）从雅桥以南的一个小山坡上挖掘出来的，具有很高的物质价值。 它的特征类似于中期前半期的石谷类型，但在中国地区出土的这种小型四节铜钟，其鳍的上缘有一对装饰性的耳朵，所以有可能是在这个地区制作的。
